patch_list: Removes banners and interstitials and makes rewarded ads pay out instantly without a video. Ad-gated buttons stay usable even when no ad is filled or the placement config is missing.
On a fresh install, "Restore Purchases" reports the no-ads pack and the yearly VIP subscription as already owned, so those entitlements activate without a real Google Play purchase.
